item_name: Rothco NYPD Style Leather Badge Holder With Clip
item_short_desc: Rothco’s NYPD Style Leather Badge Holder with Clip is designed to provide a secure and professional way to display your badge. The holder features a 2 inches x 2 1/2 inches cutout specifically tailored for NYPD style badges, ensuring a snug and accurate fit. Equipped with pinholes, your badge stays firmly in place, whether clipped to your belt or worn around your neck with the included 32-inch neck chain. The interior pocket offers a convenient storage solution for the chain when not in use.
